summary:
PROJECT ECHO – Every Craft Has a Story
Project ECHO is an interactive platform that explores NASA's equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It tells the stories of these machines, their missions, discoveries, and what happened to them after their work ended.
What Problem Does It Solve?
Most people know about space missions, but very few know about the equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Information about these machines is also scattered across different sources.
Project ECHO brings these stories together in one place, making them easy and interesting to explore. It helps students and space enthusiasts understand the history and scientific contributions of these forgotten machines.
Our goal is simple: to make sure these machines and their stories are never forgotten.
details:
Project ECHO is an interactive digital space museum that helps people discover NASA's equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

For example, when a rover completes its mission or a lunar lander finishes its job, the equipment may remain on the surface. Instead of letting these machines become forgotten pieces of hardware, ECHO tells their stories.

Users can learn:

What the equipment was designed to do.

Which NASA mission it belonged to.

What discoveries it helped make.

Where it is now.

What happened when its mission ended.
